change-advisory.pipeline.yaml:
pipeline:
  name: Change Advisory Go No-Go
  identifier: changeAdvisory
  projectIdentifier: "{{projectId}}"
  orgIdentifier: "{{orgId}}"
  tags: {}
  variables:
    - name: llmConnector
      type: String
      description: Account, org, or project LLM connector reference, for example account.harnessAnthropic.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: modelName
      type: String
      description: Model identifier your LLM connector exposes.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: team_name
      type: String
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: request_json
      type: String
      description: JSON request payload for this agent. See the usage guide for the shape.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: confluence_space
      type: String
      description: Confluence space key holding the CAB checklist. Leave empty to skip Confluence.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: jira_project
      type: String
      description: Jira project searched for unresolved risks. Leave empty to skip Jira.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: atlassian_cloud_id
      type: String
      description: Atlassian cloudId, required only when using Confluence or Jira.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: harness_api_key_secret
      type: String
      description: Expression that resolves to a Harness PAT, for example <+secrets.getValue("harness_pat")>.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: harness_base_url
      type: String
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(https://app.harness.io)
    - name: harness_account_id
      type: String
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: harness_org
      type: String
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: harness_project
      type: String
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: slack_channel_id
      type: String
      description: Slack channel id. Leave empty to skip posting.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: slack_thread_ts
      type: String
      description: Slack permalink or thread timestamp to reply in.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: slack_bot_token_secret
      type: String
      description: Expression that resolves to a Slack bot token with chat:write.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: team_skill_git_url
      type: String
      description: Optional git repo holding a team skill pack.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: team_skill_git_ref
      type: String
      required: false
      value: <+input>.default(main)
    - name: team_skill_path
      type: String
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: plugin_git_user
      type: String
      required: false
      value: <+input>.default(token)
    - name: plugin_git_token_secret
      type: String
      description: Expression that resolves to a git PAT for the skill pack checkout.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
  stages:
    - stage:
        name: Run Agent
        identifier: Run_Agent
        type: CI
        spec:
          cloneCodebase: false
          platform:
            os: Linux
            arch: Amd64
          runtime:
            type: Cloud
            spec: {}
          execution:
            steps:
              - step:
                  type: Run
                  name: Prepare Request
                  identifier: prepare_request
                  timeout: 5m
                  spec:
                    shell: Bash
                    envVariables:
                      REQUEST_JSON: <+pipeline.variables.request_json>
                    command: |-
                      set -euo pipefail
                      PREPARED_OUTPUT="$(python3 - <<'PY'
                      import base64, json, os, sys

                      unresolved_prefix = chr(60) + chr(43)


                      def configured(name):
                          value = (os.environ.get(name) or "").strip()
                          if not value or value == "null" or value.startswith(unresolved_prefix):
                              return ""
                          return value


                      raw = configured("REQUEST_JSON")
                      if not raw:
                          print("request_json is required", file=sys.stderr)
                          sys.exit(1)
                      try:
                          body = json.loads(raw)
                          if isinstance(body, str):
                              body = json.loads(body)
                      except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                          print("request_json is not valid JSON: " + str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
                          sys.exit(1)
                      if not isinstance(body, dict):
                          print("request_json must be a JSON object", file=sys.stderr)
                          sys.exit(1)
                      encoded = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(body, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).decode()
                      print("REQUEST_B64=" + encoded)
                      PY
                      )"
                      printf '%s\n' "$PREPARED_OUTPUT"
                      REQUEST_B64=""
                      while IFS='=' read -r name value; do
                        case "$name" in
                          REQUEST_B64) REQUEST_B64="$value" ;;
                        esac
                      done <<EOF
                      $PREPARED_OUTPUT
                      EOF
                      if [ -z "$REQUEST_B64" ]; then
                        echo "Prepare step failed to produce REQUEST_B64" >&2
                        exit 1
                      fi
                      export REQUEST_B64
                    outputVariables:
                      - name: REQUEST_B64
                        type: String
                        value: REQUEST_B64
              - step:
                  type: Agent
                  name: Run Change Advisory
                  identifier: run_agent_step
                  timeout: 40m
                  spec:
                    agentName: ca_change_advisory
                    agentSettings: |-
                      {
                        "llmConnector": "<+pipeline.variables.llmConnector>",
                        "team_name": "<+pipeline.variables.team_name>",
                        "modelName": "<+pipeline.variables.modelName>",
                        "agent_request_b64": "<+execution.steps.prepare_request.output.outputVariables.REQUEST_B64>",
                        "confluence_space": "<+pipeline.variables.confluence_space>",
                        "jira_project": "<+pipeline.variables.jira_project>",
                        "atlassian_cloud_id": "<+pipeline.variables.atlassian_cloud_id>",
                        "harness_api_key": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_api_key_secret>",
                        "harness_base_url": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_base_url>",
                        "harness_account_id": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_account_id>",
                        "harness_org": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_org>",
                        "harness_project": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_project>",
                        "team_skill_git_url": "<+pipeline.variables.team_skill_git_url>",
                        "team_skill_git_ref": "<+pipeline.variables.team_skill_git_ref>",
                        "team_skill_path": "<+pipeline.variables.team_skill_path>",
                        "plugin_git_user": "<+pipeline.variables.plugin_git_user>",
                        "plugin_git_token": "<+pipeline.variables.plugin_git_token_secret>"
                      }
              - step:
                  type: Run
                  name: Export Summary
                  identifier: export_summary
                  timeout: 5m
                  spec:
                    shell: Bash
                    command: |-
                      set -euo pipefail
                      SUMMARY_FILE="/harness/.agent/output/summary.md"
                      if [ ! -s "$SUMMARY_FILE" ]; then
                        echo "Missing or empty summary at $SUMMARY_FILE" >&2
                        ls -la /harness/.agent/output || true
                        exit 1
                      fi
                      echo "--- Agent summary ---"
                      cat "$SUMMARY_FILE"
                      echo "--- End summary ---"
                      SUMMARY_B64="$(python3 -c 'import base64,pathlib; print(base64.b64encode(pathlib.Path("/harness/.agent/output/summary.md").read_bytes()).decode(), end="")')"
                      echo "SUMMARY_B64=${SUMMARY_B64}"
                    outputVariables:
                      - name: SUMMARY_B64
                        type: String
                        value: SUMMARY_B64
              - step:
                  type: Run
                  name: Post Summary To Slack
                  identifier: post_summary_to_slack
                  timeout: 5m
                  when:
                    stageStatus: Success
                    condition: <+pipeline.variables.slack_thread_ts> != "" || <+pipeline.variables.slack_channel_id> != ""
                  spec:
                    shell: Bash
                    envVariables:
                      SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: <+pipeline.variables.slack_bot_token_secret>
                      SLACK_CHANNEL_ID: <+pipeline.variables.slack_channel_id>
                      SLACK_THREAD_TS: <+pipeline.variables.slack_thread_ts>
                      SUMMARY_B64: <+execution.steps.export_summary.output.outputVariables.SUMMARY_B64>
                      TITLE: <+pipeline.variables.team_name>
                      PIPELINE_EXECUTION_URL: <+pipeline.executionUrl>
                    command: |-
                      set -euo pipefail
                      python3 - <<'PY'
                      import base64, json, os, re, urllib.request

                      SLACK_TS_RE = re.compile(r"^\d+\.\d+$")
                      SLACK_P_RE = re.compile(r"(?:^|/)p(\d{10,})(?:\b|[/?#]|$)")
                      SLACK_CHANNEL_RE = re.compile(r"/archives/([CGD][A-Z0-9]+)/", re.I)


                      def normalize_slack_ts(raw):
                          value = (raw or "").strip().strip('"').strip("'")
                          unresolved_prefix = chr(60) + chr(43)
                          if not value or value == "null" or value.startswith(unresolved_prefix):
                              return ""
                          if SLACK_TS_RE.match(value):
                              return value
                          match = SLACK_P_RE.search(value)
                          digits = match.group(1) if match else ""
                          if not digits or len(digits) <= 6:
                              return ""
                          return digits[:-6] + "." + digits[-6:]


                      token = (os.environ.get("SLACK_BOT_TOKEN") or "").strip()
                      if not token:
                          raise RuntimeError("slack_bot_token_secret is required to post")
                      thread_raw = os.environ.get("SLACK_THREAD_TS", "").strip()
                      channel_match = SLACK_CHANNEL_RE.search(thread_raw)
                      channel_id = (channel_match.group(1).upper() if channel_match else os.environ.get("SLACK_CHANNEL_ID", "").strip())
                      if not channel_id:
                          raise RuntimeError("Set slack_channel_id or pass a Slack permalink")
                      summary_b64 = os.environ.get("SUMMARY_B64", "").strip()
                      if not summary_b64:
                          raise RuntimeError("Missing summary")
                      summary = base64.b64decode(summary_b64 + "=" * (-len(summary_b64) % 4)).decode()
                      team = os.environ.get("TITLE", "agent").strip()
                      exec_url = os.environ.get("PIPELINE_EXECUTION_URL", "").strip()
                      footer = f"\n_<{exec_url}|pipeline execution>_" if exec_url.startswith("http") else ""
                      thread_ts = normalize_slack_ts(thread_raw)
                      body = {
                          "channel": channel_id,
                          "text": (f"*[{team}]*\n" + summary + footer)[:39000],
                          "unfurl_links": False,
                          "unfurl_media": False,
                      }
                      if thread_ts:
                          body["thread_ts"] = thread_ts
                      req = urllib.request.Request(
                          "https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage",
                          data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
                          headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token, "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8"},
                          method="POST",
                      )
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp:
                          data = json.loads(resp.read())
                      if not data.get("ok"):
                          raise RuntimeError("chat.postMessage: " + str(data.get("error")))
                      print("Posted Slack ts=" + str(data.get("ts")))
                      PY
        failureStrategies:
          - onFailure:
              errors:
                - AllErrors
              action:
                type: MarkAsFailure
container-vuln-remediation.pipeline.yaml:
pipeline:
  name: Container Vulnerability Remediation
  identifier: containerVulnRemediation
  projectIdentifier: "{{projectId}}"
  orgIdentifier: "{{orgId}}"
  tags: {}
  properties:
    ci:
      codebase:
        repoName: <+input>
        build: <+input>
  variables:
    - name: llmConnector
      type: String
      description: Account, org, or project LLM connector reference, for example account.YOUR_LLM_CONNECTOR.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: modelName
      type: String
      description: Model identifier your LLM connector exposes.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: cloudConnector
      type: String
      description: Cloud connector used by BuildAndPushECR. The sample keeps PLUGIN_NO_PUSH=true so the image stays local for Trivy.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: awsRegion
      type: String
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(us-east-1)
    - name: awsAccountId
      type: String
      description: AWS account id for the ECR image name. Not used to push when PLUGIN_NO_PUSH is true.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: imageName
      type: String
      description: Image repository name, for example my-service.
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(my-service)
    - name: dockerfile
      type: String
      description: Path to the Dockerfile inside the cloned repo.
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(Dockerfile)
    - name: dockerContext
      type: String
      description: Docker build context directory.
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(.)
    - name: harness_api_key_secret
      type: String
      description: Expression that resolves to a Harness API key or PAT, for example <+secrets.getValue("harness_pat")>.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: harness_base_url
      type: String
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(https://app.harness.io)
    - name: gitUserEmail
      type: String
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(ci-bot@example.com)
    - name: gitUserName
      type: String
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(Harness CI)
    - name: repoOwner
      type: String
      description: GitHub org or user that owns the repository. Used only when opening a pull request.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: repoName
      type: String
      description: GitHub repository name. Used only when opening a pull request.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: scm_token_secret
      type: String
      description: Expression that resolves to a GitHub token with pull-request permission, for example <+secrets.getValue("YOUR_SCM_TOKEN_SECRET")>.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
  stages:
    - stage:
        name: Build
        identifier: Build
        type: CI
        spec:
          cloneCodebase: true
          platform:
            os: Linux
            arch: Amd64
          runtime:
            type: Cloud
            spec:
              size: medium
          sharedPaths:
            - /shared/scan_results
          execution:
            steps:
              - stepGroup:
                  name: Build Image
                  identifier: build_push_ecr
                  steps:
                    - step:
                        type: BuildAndPushECR
                        name: Build Local Image
                        identifier: build_local_image
                        spec:
                          connectorRef: <+pipeline.variables.cloudConnector>
                          region: <+pipeline.variables.awsRegion>
                          account: <+pipeline.variables.awsAccountId>
                          imageName: <+pipeline.variables.imageName>
                          tags:
                            - <+pipeline.sequenceId>
                          caching: true
                          dockerfile: <+pipeline.variables.dockerfile>
                          context: <+pipeline.variables.dockerContext>
                          envVariables:
                            PLUGIN_TAR_PATH: /harness/image.tar
                            PLUGIN_NO_PUSH: "true"
                            PLUGIN_BUILDX_LOAD: "true"
              - stepGroup:
                  name: Security Container
                  identifier: security_container
                  failureStrategies:
                    - onFailure:
                        errors:
                          - AllErrors
                        action:
                          type: MarkAsFailure
                  steps:
                    - step:
                        type: Run
                        name: Trivy JSON Scan
                        identifier: trivy_scan_json
                        spec:
                          image: aquasec/trivy:latest
                          shell: Sh
                          command: |
                            mkdir -p /shared/scan_results
                            trivy image --input /harness/image.tar \
                              --format json \
                              --output /shared/scan_results/trivy-results.json \
                              --severity CRITICAL,HIGH \
                              --ignore-unfixed \
                              || true
                            echo "Trivy JSON saved to /shared/scan_results/trivy-results.json"
                          privileged: true
                    - step:
                        type: AquaTrivy
                        name: Trivy Orchestration Scan
                        identifier: trivy_scan
                        spec:
                          mode: orchestration
                          config: default
                          target:
                            type: container
                            workspace: /harness/image.tar
                            name: <+pipeline.variables.imageName>
                            variant: <+pipeline.sequenceId>
                          advanced:
                            log:
                              level: info
                            fail_on_severity: high
                          privileged: true
                          image:
                            type: local_archive
                            tag: <+pipeline.sequenceId>
                            name: <+pipeline.variables.imageName>
                          sbom:
                            generate: true
                            format: spdx-json
              - parallel:
                  - step:
                      type: Run
                      name: Build Manifest
                      identifier: build_manifest
                      spec:
                        shell: Sh
                        command: |
                          echo "{\"pipeline\":\"<+pipeline.identifier>\",\"build\":\"<+pipeline.sequenceId>\",\"commit\":\"<+codebase.commitSha>\",\"branch\":\"<+codebase.branch>\",\"imageTag\":\"<+pipeline.sequenceId>\"}"
                  - stepGroup:
                      name: Remediation Steps
                      identifier: Remediation_Steps
                      when:
                        stageStatus: Failure
                      steps:
                        - step:
                            type: Run
                            name: Fetch STO Vulnerabilities Round 1
                            identifier: fetch_sto_vulnerabilities
                            spec:
                              shell: Sh
                              command: |-
                                set -e
                                mkdir -p /shared/scan_results
                                ACCOUNT_ID="<+account.identifier>"
                                ORG_ID="<+org.identifier>"
                                PROJECT_ID="<+project.identifier>"
                                EXECUTION_ID="<+pipeline.executionId>"
                                BASE_URL="<+pipeline.variables.harness_base_url>"

                                RESPONSE=$(curl -sS --url "${BASE_URL}/gateway/sto/api/v2/frontend/pipeline-security/v2/issues?accountId=${ACCOUNT_ID}&orgId=${ORG_ID}&projectId=${PROJECT_ID}&executionId=${EXECUTION_ID}&page=0&pageSize=50&severityCodes=Critical%2CHigh&includeExempted=false&isRemediationAgentTab=false" \
                                  -H "accept: application/json" \
                                  -H "content-type: application/json" \
                                  -H "x-api-key: ${HARNESS_API_TOKEN}" \
                                  -H "harness-account: ${ACCOUNT_ID}")

                                echo "$RESPONSE" > /shared/scan_results/sto-issues-round1.json

                                SCAN_ID=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"scanId":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/"scanId":"//g' | sed 's/"//g')
                                ISSUE_IDS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | sed 's/"id":"//g' | sed 's/"//g' | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')
                                CRITICAL_COUNT=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"severityCode":"Critical"' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
                                HIGH_COUNT=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"severityCode":"High"' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
                                ISSUES=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"title":"[^"]*"' | sed 's/"title":"//g' | sed 's/"$//g' | head -20 | tr '\n' ' | ' | sed 's/ | $//')

                                echo "SCAN_ID=$SCAN_ID" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                echo "ISSUE_IDS=$ISSUE_IDS" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                echo "INITIAL_CRITICAL=$CRITICAL_COUNT" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                echo "INITIAL_HIGH=$HIGH_COUNT" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE

                                if [ -z "$ISSUES" ]; then
                                  REMEDIATION_DETAILS="No critical or high vulnerabilities found in STO scan."
                                else
                                  REMEDIATION_DETAILS="STO found ${CRITICAL_COUNT} Critical and ${HIGH_COUNT} High vulnerabilities. Issues: ${ISSUES}"
                                fi
                                echo "REMEDIATION_DETAILS=$REMEDIATION_DETAILS" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                              envVariables:
                                HARNESS_API_TOKEN: <+pipeline.variables.harness_api_key_secret>
                              outputVariables:
                                - name: REMEDIATION_DETAILS
                                  type: String
                                  value: REMEDIATION_DETAILS
                                - name: SCAN_ID
                                  type: String
                                  value: SCAN_ID
                                - name: ISSUE_IDS
                                  type: String
                                  value: ISSUE_IDS
                                - name: INITIAL_CRITICAL
                                  type: String
                                  value: INITIAL_CRITICAL
                                - name: INITIAL_HIGH
                                  type: String
                                  value: INITIAL_HIGH
                            failureStrategies:
                              - onFailure:
                                  errors:
                                    - AllErrors
                                  action:
                                    type: Ignore
                        - step:
                            type: Run
                            name: Fetch Vulnerability Details Round 1
                            identifier: fetch_vulnerability_details
                            spec:
                              image: alpine:latest
                              shell: Sh
                              command: |-
                                apk add --no-cache curl jq
                                ACCOUNT_ID="<+account.identifier>"
                                ORG_ID="<+org.identifier>"
                                PROJECT_ID="<+project.identifier>"
                                SCAN_ID="<+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities.output.outputVariables.SCAN_ID>"
                                ISSUE_IDS="<+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities.output.outputVariables.ISSUE_IDS>"
                                BASE_URL="<+pipeline.variables.harness_base_url>"
                                mkdir -p /shared/scan_results
                                JSON_REPORT="/shared/scan_results/remediation_report_round1.json"
                                echo '[]' > "$JSON_REPORT"
                                VULN_COUNT=0
                                CRITICAL_COUNT=0
                                HIGH_COUNT=0
                                for ISSUE_ID in $(echo "$ISSUE_IDS" | tr ',' ' '); do
                                  [ -z "$ISSUE_ID" ] && continue
                                  DETAIL_RESPONSE=$(curl -sS --url "${BASE_URL}/gateway/sto/api/v2/scans/${SCAN_ID}/issue/${ISSUE_ID}?accountId=${ACCOUNT_ID}&orgId=${ORG_ID}&projectId=${PROJECT_ID}&page=0&pageSize=20" \
                                    -H "accept: application/json" \
                                    -H "content-type: application/json" \
                                    -H "x-api-key: ${HARNESS_API_TOKEN}" \
                                    -H "harness-account: ${ACCOUNT_ID}")
                                  SIMPLIFIED=$(echo "$DETAIL_RESPONSE" | jq -c '{
                                    cve: .title,
                                    severity: .severityCode,
                                    library: .details.libraryName,
                                    current: .details.currentVersion,
                                    fixed: .details.upgradeVersion,
                                    remediation: .details.remediationSteps
                                  }')
                                  CURRENT_JSON=$(cat "$JSON_REPORT")
                                  echo "$CURRENT_JSON" | jq --argjson item "$SIMPLIFIED" '. + [$item]' > "$JSON_REPORT"
                                  SEVERITY=$(echo "$DETAIL_RESPONSE" | jq -r '.severityCode // "Unknown"')
                                  if [ "$SEVERITY" = "Critical" ]; then CRITICAL_COUNT=$((CRITICAL_COUNT + 1)); fi
                                  if [ "$SEVERITY" = "High" ]; then HIGH_COUNT=$((HIGH_COUNT + 1)); fi
                                  VULN_COUNT=$((VULN_COUNT + 1))
                                done
                                echo "VULN_COUNT=$VULN_COUNT" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                echo "CRITICAL_COUNT=$CRITICAL_COUNT" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                echo "HIGH_COUNT=$HIGH_COUNT" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                echo "JSON_REPORT=$JSON_REPORT" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                              envVariables:
                                HARNESS_API_TOKEN: <+pipeline.variables.harness_api_key_secret>
                              outputVariables:
                                - name: VULN_COUNT
                                  type: String
                                  value: VULN_COUNT
                                - name: CRITICAL_COUNT
                                  type: String
                                  value: CRITICAL_COUNT
                                - name: HIGH_COUNT
                                  type: String
                                  value: HIGH_COUNT
                                - name: JSON_REPORT
                                  type: String
                                  value: JSON_REPORT
                            failureStrategies:
                              - onFailure:
                                  errors:
                                    - AllErrors
                                  action:
                                    type: Ignore
                        - step:
                            type: Agent
                            name: Remediation Agent Round 1
                            identifier: Agent_1
                            spec:
                              agentName: ca_container_vuln_remediation
                              agentSettings:
                                llmConnector: <+pipeline.variables.llmConnector>
                                modelName: <+pipeline.variables.modelName>
                                remediationDetails: <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities.output.outputVariables.REMEDIATION_DETAILS>
                                remediationReport: <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_vulnerability_details.output.outputVariables.JSON_REPORT>
                        - step:
                            type: Run
                            name: Show Dockerfile After Round 1
                            identifier: Show_Dockerfile_Fixed
                            spec:
                              shell: Sh
                              command: |
                                echo "=== Dockerfile after Round 1 remediation ==="
                                cat <+pipeline.variables.dockerfile>
                        - step:
                            type: BuildAndPushECR
                            name: Rebuild Image Round 1
                            identifier: rebuild_image_round_1
                            spec:
                              connectorRef: <+pipeline.variables.cloudConnector>
                              region: <+pipeline.variables.awsRegion>
                              account: <+pipeline.variables.awsAccountId>
                              imageName: <+pipeline.variables.imageName>
                              tags:
                                - <+pipeline.sequenceId>

                                SCAN_ID_R2=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"scanId":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/"scanId":"//g' | sed 's/"//g')
                                ISSUE_IDS_R2=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | sed 's/"id":"//g' | sed 's/"//g' | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')

                                ROUND2_HIGH=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"severityCode":"High"' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
                                ISSUES=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"title":"[^"]*"' | sed 's/"title":"//g' | sed 's/"$//g' | head -20 | tr '\n' ' | ' | sed 's/ | $//')

                                if [ -z "$ISSUES" ] || { [ "$ROUND2_CRITICAL" -eq 0 ] && [ "$ROUND2_HIGH" -eq 0 ]; }; then
                                  REMEDIATION_DETAILS_R2="All critical and high vulnerabilities resolved after Round 1 remediation."
                                  NEEDS_ROUND2="false"
                                else
                                  REMEDIATION_DETAILS_R2="After Round 1: still ${ROUND2_CRITICAL} Critical and ${ROUND2_HIGH} High. Remaining: ${ISSUES}"
                                  NEEDS_ROUND2="true"
                                fi
                                echo "NEEDS_ROUND2=$NEEDS_ROUND2" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                echo "REMEDIATION_DETAILS_R2=$REMEDIATION_DETAILS_R2" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                              envVariables:

                              outputVariables:

                                - name: ISSUE_IDS_R2

                                - name: ROUND2_HIGH

                            failureStrategies:

                                NEEDS_ROUND2="<+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.NEEDS_ROUND2>"
                                JSON_REPORT="/shared/scan_results/remediation_report_round2.json"

                                if [ "$NEEDS_ROUND2" != "true" ]; then
                                  echo "VULN_COUNT_R2=0" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                  echo "CRITICAL_COUNT_R2=0" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                  echo "HIGH_COUNT_R2=0" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE

                                ACCOUNT_ID="<+account.identifier>"

                                PROJECT_ID="<+project.identifier>"
                                SCAN_ID="<+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.SCAN_ID_R2>"
                                ISSUE_IDS="<+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.ISSUE_IDS_R2>"
                                BASE_URL="<+pipeline.variables.harness_base_url>"
                                VULN_COUNT=0
                                CRITICAL_COUNT=0
                                HIGH_COUNT=0
                                for ISSUE_ID in $(echo "$ISSUE_IDS" | tr ',' ' '); do
                                  [ -z "$ISSUE_ID" ] && continue
                                  DETAIL_RESPONSE=$(curl -sS --url "${BASE_URL}/gateway/sto/api/v2/scans/${SCAN_ID}/issue/${ISSUE_ID}?accountId=${ACCOUNT_ID}&orgId=${ORG_ID}&projectId=${PROJECT_ID}&page=0&pageSize=20" \
                                    -H "accept: application/json" \
                                    -H "content-type: application/json" \
                                    -H "x-api-key: ${HARNESS_API_TOKEN}" \
                                    -H "harness-account: ${ACCOUNT_ID}")
                                  SIMPLIFIED=$(echo "$DETAIL_RESPONSE" | jq -c '{
                                    cve: .title,
                                    severity: .severityCode,
                                    library: .details.libraryName,
                                    current: .details.currentVersion,
                                    fixed: .details.upgradeVersion,
                                    remediation: .details.remediationSteps
                                  }')
                                  CURRENT_JSON=$(cat "$JSON_REPORT")
                                  echo "$CURRENT_JSON" | jq --argjson item "$SIMPLIFIED" '. + [$item]' > "$JSON_REPORT"
                                  SEVERITY=$(echo "$DETAIL_RESPONSE" | jq -r '.severityCode // "Unknown"')
                                  if [ "$SEVERITY" = "Critical" ]; then CRITICAL_COUNT=$((CRITICAL_COUNT + 1)); fi
                                  if [ "$SEVERITY" = "High" ]; then HIGH_COUNT=$((HIGH_COUNT + 1)); fi
                                  VULN_COUNT=$((VULN_COUNT + 1))
                                done
                                echo "VULN_COUNT_R2=$VULN_COUNT" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                echo "CRITICAL_COUNT_R2=$CRITICAL_COUNT" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                echo "HIGH_COUNT_R2=$HIGH_COUNT" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                echo "JSON_REPORT_R2=$JSON_REPORT" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                              envVariables:
                                HARNESS_API_TOKEN: <+pipeline.variables.harness_api_key_secret>
                              outputVariables:
                                - name: VULN_COUNT_R2
                                  type: String
                                  value: VULN_COUNT_R2
                                - name: CRITICAL_COUNT_R2
                                  type: String
                                  value: CRITICAL_COUNT_R2
                                - name: HIGH_COUNT_R2
                                  type: String
                                  value: HIGH_COUNT_R2
                                - name: JSON_REPORT_R2
                                  type: String
                                  value: JSON_REPORT_R2
                            failureStrategies:
                              - onFailure:
                                  errors:
                                    - AllErrors
                                  action:
                                    type: Ignore
                        - step:
                            type: Agent
                            name: Remediation Agent Round 2
                            identifier: Agent_2
                            spec:
                              agentName: ca_container_vuln_remediation
                              agentSettings:
                                llmConnector: <+pipeline.variables.llmConnector>
                                modelName: <+pipeline.variables.modelName>
                                remediationDetails: <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.REMEDIATION_DETAILS_R2>
                                remediationReport: <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_vulnerability_details_round2.output.outputVariables.JSON_REPORT_R2>
                                previousAttempts: Round 1 reduced vulnerabilities from <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities.output.outputVariables.INITIAL_CRITICAL> Critical/<+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities.output.outputVariables.INITIAL_HIGH> High to <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.ROUND2_CRITICAL> Critical/<+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.ROUND2_HIGH> High. Fix remaining issues without repeating a failed strategy.
                            when:
                              stageStatus: Failure
                              condition: <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.NEEDS_ROUND2> == "true"
                        - step:
                            type: BuildAndPushECR
                            name: Rebuild Image Round 2
                            identifier: rebuild_image_round_2
                            spec:
                              connectorRef: <+pipeline.variables.cloudConnector>
                              region: <+pipeline.variables.awsRegion>
                              account: <+pipeline.variables.awsAccountId>
                              imageName: <+pipeline.variables.imageName>
                              tags:
                                - <+pipeline.sequenceId>
                              caching: true
                              dockerfile: <+pipeline.variables.dockerfile>
                              context: <+pipeline.variables.dockerContext>
                              envVariables:
                                PLUGIN_TAR_PATH: /harness/image.tar
                                PLUGIN_NO_PUSH: "true"
                                PLUGIN_BUILDX_LOAD: "true"
                            when:
                              stageStatus: Failure
                              condition: <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.NEEDS_ROUND2> == "true"
                        - step:
                            type: AquaTrivy
                            name: Rescan After Round 2
                            identifier: trivy_scan_fixed_two
                            spec:
                              mode: orchestration
                              config: default
                              target:
                                type: container
                                workspace: /harness/image.tar
                                name: <+pipeline.variables.imageName>
                                variant: <+pipeline.sequenceId>-r2
                              advanced:
                                log:
                                  level: info
                                fail_on_severity: high
                              privileged: true
                              image:
                                type: local_archive
                                tag: <+pipeline.sequenceId>
                                name: <+pipeline.variables.imageName>
                              sbom:
                                generate: true
                                format: spdx-json
                            when:
                              stageStatus: Failure
                              condition: <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.NEEDS_ROUND2> == "true"
                            failureStrategies:
                              - onFailure:
                                  errors:
                                    - AllErrors
                                  action:
                                    type: Ignore
                        - step:
                            type: Run
                            name: Fetch Final STO Results
                            identifier: fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round3
                            spec:
                              shell: Sh
                              command: |-
                                NEEDS_ROUND2="<+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.NEEDS_ROUND2>"
                                if [ "$NEEDS_ROUND2" != "true" ]; then
                                  FINAL_CRITICAL="<+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.ROUND2_CRITICAL>"
                                  FINAL_HIGH="<+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.ROUND2_HIGH>"
                                  REMEDIATION_DETAILS_FINAL="Round 2 was not needed. Remaining Critical/High counts are from the Round 1 rescan."
                                  echo "FINAL_CRITICAL=$FINAL_CRITICAL" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                  echo "FINAL_HIGH=$FINAL_HIGH" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                  echo "REMEDIATION_DETAILS_FINAL=$REMEDIATION_DETAILS_FINAL" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                  exit 0
                                fi
                                ACCOUNT_ID="<+account.identifier>"
                                ORG_ID="<+org.identifier>"
                                PROJECT_ID="<+project.identifier>"
                                EXECUTION_ID="<+pipeline.executionId>"
                                BASE_URL="<+pipeline.variables.harness_base_url>"
                                sleep 5
                                RESPONSE=$(curl -sS --url "${BASE_URL}/gateway/sto/api/v2/frontend/pipeline-security/v2/issues?accountId=${ACCOUNT_ID}&orgId=${ORG_ID}&projectId=${PROJECT_ID}&executionId=${EXECUTION_ID}&page=0&pageSize=50&stages=Build&steps=Build.Remediation_Steps_trivy_scan_fixed_two&severityCodes=Critical%2CHigh&includeExempted=false&isRemediationAgentTab=false" \
                                  -H "accept: application/json" \
                                  -H "content-type: application/json" \
                                  -H "x-api-key: ${HARNESS_API_TOKEN}" \
                                  -H "harness-account: ${ACCOUNT_ID}")
                                echo "$RESPONSE" > /shared/scan_results/sto-issues-round3.json
                                FINAL_CRITICAL=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"severityCode":"Critical"' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
                                FINAL_HIGH=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"severityCode":"High"' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
                                ISSUES=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"title":"[^"]*"' | sed 's/"title":"//g' | sed 's/"$//g' | head -20 | tr '\n' ' | ' | sed 's/ | $//')
                                echo "FINAL_CRITICAL=$FINAL_CRITICAL" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                echo "FINAL_HIGH=$FINAL_HIGH" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                if [ -z "$ISSUES" ] || { [ "$FINAL_CRITICAL" -eq 0 ] && [ "$FINAL_HIGH" -eq 0 ]; }; then
                                  REMEDIATION_DETAILS_FINAL="All critical and high vulnerabilities resolved after 2 rounds of remediation."
                                else
                                  REMEDIATION_DETAILS_FINAL="After Round 2: still ${FINAL_CRITICAL} Critical and ${FINAL_HIGH} High. Remaining: ${ISSUES}"
                                fi
                                echo "REMEDIATION_DETAILS_FINAL=$REMEDIATION_DETAILS_FINAL" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                              envVariables:
                                HARNESS_API_TOKEN: <+pipeline.variables.harness_api_key_secret>
                              outputVariables:
                                - name: FINAL_CRITICAL
                                  type: String
                                  value: FINAL_CRITICAL
                                - name: FINAL_HIGH
                                  type: String
                                  value: FINAL_HIGH
                                - name: REMEDIATION_DETAILS_FINAL
                                  type: String
                                  value: REMEDIATION_DETAILS_FINAL
                        - step:
                            type: Run
                            name: Commit Dockerfile Fixes
                            identifier: commit_and_push
                            spec:
                              shell: Sh
                              command: |
                                set -e
                                cd /harness
                                git config user.email "<+pipeline.variables.gitUserEmail>"
                                git config user.name "<+pipeline.variables.gitUserName>"
                                git add <+pipeline.variables.dockerfile> .trivyignore || true
                                if git diff --cached --quiet; then
                                  echo "No Dockerfile or ignore-file changes to commit."
                                  echo "VULN_FIX_BRANCH=" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                  exit 0
                                fi
                                VULN_FIX_BRANCH="fix/container-vuln-remediation-<+pipeline.sequenceId>"
                                git checkout -b "$VULN_FIX_BRANCH"
                                git commit -m "fix: remediate container vulnerabilities - build <+pipeline.sequenceId>

                                Automated vulnerability remediation applied by the catalog Container Vulnerability Remediation agent."
                                git push origin "$VULN_FIX_BRANCH"
                                echo "VULN_FIX_BRANCH=$VULN_FIX_BRANCH" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                              outputVariables:
                                - name: VULN_FIX_BRANCH
                                  type: String
                                  value: VULN_FIX_BRANCH
                        - step:
                            type: Run
                            name: Create Pull Request
                            identifier: create_pull_request
                            spec:
                              shell: Sh
                              command: |-
                                set -e
                                VULN_FIX_BRANCH="<+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.commit_and_push.output.outputVariables.VULN_FIX_BRANCH>"
                                if [ -z "$VULN_FIX_BRANCH" ]; then
                                  echo "No fix branch was pushed. Skipping pull request."
                                  echo "PR_URL=" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                  echo "PR_NUMBER=" >> $HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                  exit 0
                                fi
                                export PR_TITLE="fix: container vulnerability remediation - build <+pipeline.sequenceId>"
                                export PR_BODY="Automated Dockerfile remediation from Harness pipeline <+pipeline.identifier> build <+pipeline.sequenceId>.

                                Initial: <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities.output.outputVariables.REMEDIATION_DETAILS>

                                After round 1: <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round2.output.outputVariables.REMEDIATION_DETAILS_R2>

                                Final: <+execution.steps.Remediation_Steps.steps.fetch_sto_vulnerabilities_round3.output.outputVariables.REMEDIATION_DETAILS_FINAL>"
                                export VULN_FIX_BRANCH
                                export BASE_BRANCH="<+codebase.branch>"
                                export GH_TOKEN
                                export REPO_OWNER="<+pipeline.variables.repoOwner>"
                                export REPO_NAME="<+pipeline.variables.repoName>"
                                export HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE
                                python3 << 'PYEOF'
                                import json, os, re, urllib.error, urllib.request

                                def clean(s):
                                    return re.sub(r"[\x00-\x08\x0b-\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]", "", s or "")

                                payload = {
                                    "title": clean(os.environ.get("PR_TITLE", "")),
                                    "body": clean(os.environ.get("PR_BODY", "")),
                                    "head": clean(os.environ.get("VULN_FIX_BRANCH", "")),
                                    "base": clean(os.environ.get("BASE_BRANCH", "")),
                                }
                                data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
                                req = urllib.request.Request(
                                    "https://api.github.com/repos/%s/%s/pulls" % (os.environ["REPO_OWNER"], os.environ["REPO_NAME"]),
                                    data=data,
                                    headers={
                                        "Authorization": "token %s" % os.environ["GH_TOKEN"],
                                        "Accept": "application/vnd.github.v3+json",
                                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                                    },
                                    method="POST",
                                )
                                try:
                                    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                                        result = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
                                        pr_url = result.get("html_url", "")
                                        pr_number = str(result.get("number", ""))
                                        print("Pull request created:", pr_url)
                                        harness_out = os.environ.get("HARNESS_OUTPUT_FILE", "")
                                        if harness_out:
                                            with open(harness_out, "a") as handle:
                                                handle.write("PR_URL=%s\n" % pr_url)
                                                handle.write("PR_NUMBER=%s\n" % pr_number)
                                except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
                                    print("Failed to create PR:", error.read().decode("utf-8"))
                                    raise SystemExit(1)
                                PYEOF
                              envVariables:
                                GH_TOKEN: <+pipeline.variables.scm_token_secret>
                              outputVariables:
                                - name: PR_URL
                                  type: String
                                  value: PR_URL
                                - name: PR_NUMBER
                                  type: String
                                  value: PR_NUMBER

pipeline:

  identifier: dockerTagGovernance
  projectIdentifier: "{{projectId}}"
  orgIdentifier: "{{orgId}}"
  tags: {}
  variables:
    - name: llmConnector
      type: String
      description: Account, org, or project LLM connector reference.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: modelName
      type: String
      description: Model identifier exposed by your LLM connector.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: dockerRepositories
      type: String
      description: Comma-separated Docker Hub repositories in namespace/name format.
      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: cleanupMode
      type: String
      description: "Cleanup behavior: report-only, delete-with-approval, or auto-delete."
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(report-only)
    - name: retainCount
      type: String
      description: Number of most-recent tags to retain in each repository.
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(10)
    - name: protectedPatterns
      type: String
      description: Comma-separated tag patterns that must never be deleted.
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(latest,prod-*,release-*,v[0-9]*)
    - name: daysThreshold
      type: String
      description: Tags older than this many days can become deletion candidates.
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(30)
    - name: estimatedCostPerGB
      type: String
      description: Estimated monthly storage cost per GB in USD.
      required: false
      value: <+input>.default(0.50)
    - name: dockerUsername
      type: String
      description: Docker Hub username; required only when cleanup executes.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: dockerHubToken
      type: Secret
      description: Docker Hub access token secret; required only when cleanup executes.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
  stages:
    - stage:
        name: Tag Analysis
        identifier: tag_analysis
        type: CI
        spec:
          cloneCodebase: false
          platform:
            os: Linux
            arch: Amd64
          runtime:
            type: Cloud
            spec: {}
          execution:
            steps:
              - step:
                  type: Agent
                  name: Analyze Docker Tags
                  identifier: analyze_docker_tags
                  spec:
                    agentName: ca_docker_tag_governance
                    agentSettings:
                      llmConnector: <+pipeline.variables.llmConnector>
                      modelName: <+pipeline.variables.modelName>
                      dockerRepositories: <+pipeline.variables.dockerRepositories>
                      cleanupMode: report-only
                      retainCount: <+pipeline.variables.retainCount>
                      protectedPatterns: <+pipeline.variables.protectedPatterns>
                      daysThreshold: <+pipeline.variables.daysThreshold>
                      estimatedCostPerGB: <+pipeline.variables.estimatedCostPerGB>
        failureStrategies:
          - onFailure:
              errors:
                - AllErrors
              action:
                type: MarkAsFailure
    - stage:
        name: Approval Gate
        identifier: approval_gate
        type: Approval
        when:
          pipelineStatus: Success
          condition: <+pipeline.variables.cleanupMode> == "delete-with-approval"
        spec:
          execution:
            steps:
              - step:
                  type: HarnessApproval
                  name: Approve Tag Deletion
                  identifier: approve_tag_deletion
                  spec:
                    approvalMessage: |
                      Review the analysis-stage logs before approving deletion.

                      Repositories: <+pipeline.variables.dockerRepositories>
                      Retain count: <+pipeline.variables.retainCount>
                      Protected patterns: <+pipeline.variables.protectedPatterns>
                      Days threshold: <+pipeline.variables.daysThreshold>
                    includePipelineExecutionHistory: true
                    isAutoRejectEnabled: false
                    approvers:
                      userGroups:
                        - account._account_all_users
                      minimumCount: 1
                      disallowPipelineExecutor: false
                    approverInputs: []
                  timeout: 1d
        failureStrategies:
          - onFailure:
              errors:
                - AllErrors
              action:
                type: MarkAsFailure
    - stage:
        name: Execute Cleanup
        identifier: execute_cleanup
        type: CI
        when:
          pipelineStatus: Success
          condition: <+pipeline.variables.cleanupMode> == "delete-with-approval" || <+pipeline.variables.cleanupMode> == "auto-delete"
        spec:
          cloneCodebase: false
          platform:
            os: Linux
            arch: Amd64
          runtime:
            type: Cloud
            spec: {}
          execution:
            steps:
              - step:
                  type: Agent
                  name: Delete Docker Tags
                  identifier: delete_docker_tags
                  spec:
                    agentName: ca_docker_tag_governance
                    agentSettings:
                      llmConnector: <+pipeline.variables.llmConnector>
                      modelName: <+pipeline.variables.modelName>
                      dockerRepositories: <+pipeline.variables.dockerRepositories>
                      dockerUsername: <+pipeline.variables.dockerUsername>
                      dockerHubToken: <+pipeline.variables.dockerHubToken>
                      cleanupMode: auto-delete
                      retainCount: <+pipeline.variables.retainCount>
                      protectedPatterns: <+pipeline.variables.protectedPatterns>
                      daysThreshold: <+pipeline.variables.daysThreshold>
                      estimatedCostPerGB: <+pipeline.variables.estimatedCostPerGB>
        failureStrategies:
          - onFailure:
              errors:
                - AllErrors
              action:
                type: MarkAsFailure

      required: true
      value: <+input>
    - name: gitUserEmail
      type: String
      description: Email used for the automated commit.
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(ci-bot@example.com)
    - name: gitUserName
      type: String
      description: Author name used for the automated commit.
      required: true
      value: <+input>.default(Dockerfile Cache Agent)
  stages:
    - stage:
        name: Optimize Dockerfiles
        identifier: Optimize_Dockerfiles
        type: CI
        spec:
          cloneCodebase: true
          caching:
            enabled: false
            override: true
          buildIntelligence:
            enabled: false
          platform:
            os: Linux
            arch: Amd64
          runtime:
            type: Cloud
            spec: {}
          execution:
            steps:
              - step:
                  type: Agent
                  name: Dockerfile Cache Optimizer
                  identifier: Dockerfile_Cache_Optimizer
                  spec:
                    agentName: ca_dockerfilecacheoptimizernomcp
                    agentSettings:
                      llmConnector: <+pipeline.variables.llmConnector>
                      modelName: <+pipeline.variables.modelName>
              - step:
                  type: Run
                  name: Commit and Push Branch
                  identifier: Commit_And_Push_Branch
                  spec:
                    shell: Sh
                    command: |
                      set -e
                      cd /harness

                      git config user.email "<+pipeline.variables.gitUserEmail>"
                      git config user.name  "<+pipeline.variables.gitUserName>"

                      # Stage Dockerfile and .dockerignore changes anywhere in the tree
                      git add -A -- '*Dockerfile*' '*.dockerignore' '.dockerignore'

                      if git diff --cached --quiet; then
                        echo "No Dockerfile or .dockerignore changes to commit."
                        exit 0
                      fi

                      BRANCH="dockerfile-cache/agent-<+pipeline.sequenceId>"
                      git checkout -b "$BRANCH"

                      git commit -m "Optimize Dockerfile(s) for BuildKit layer caching

                      Automated changes by the Dockerfile Cache Optimizer agent.

                      Pipeline: <+pipeline.executionUrl>"

                      git push origin "$BRANCH"

                      echo ""
                      echo "Branch pushed: $BRANCH"
                      echo "Open a pull request from this branch against your default branch."

                      if [ -f /harness/agent-summary.md ]; then
                        echo ""
                        echo "=== Agent summary (use as the PR description) ==="
                        cat /harness/agent-summary.md
                      fi
                  failureStrategies:
                    - onFailure:
                        errors:
                          - AllErrors
                        action:
                          type: Ignore

    - name: harness_account_id

    - name: harness_org

    - name: harness_project

    - name: slack_channel_id
      type: String
      description: Slack channel id. Leave empty to skip posting.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: slack_thread_ts
      type: String
      description: Slack permalink or thread timestamp to reply in.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: slack_bot_token_secret
      type: String
      description: Expression that resolves to a Slack bot token with chat:write.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: team_skill_git_url
      type: String
      description: Optional git repo holding a team skill pack.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: team_skill_git_ref
      type: String
      required: false
      value: <+input>.default(main)
    - name: team_skill_path
      type: String
      required: false
      value: <+input>
    - name: plugin_git_user
      type: String
      required: false
      value: <+input>.default(token)
    - name: plugin_git_token_secret
      type: String
      description: Expression that resolves to a git PAT for the skill pack checkout.
      required: false
      value: <+input>
  stages:
    - stage:
        name: Run Agent
        identifier: Run_Agent
        type: CI
        spec:
          cloneCodebase: false
          platform:
            os: Linux
            arch: Amd64
          runtime:
            type: Cloud
            spec: {}
          execution:
            steps:
              - step:
                  type: Run
                  name: Prepare Request
                  identifier: prepare_request
                  timeout: 5m
                  spec:
                    shell: Bash
                    envVariables:
                      REQUEST_JSON: <+pipeline.variables.request_json>
                    command: |-
                      set -euo pipefail
                      PREPARED_OUTPUT="$(python3 - <<'PY'
                      import base64, json, os, sys

                      unresolved_prefix = chr(60) + chr(43)


                      def configured(name):
                          value = (os.environ.get(name) or "").strip()
                          if not value or value == "null" or value.startswith(unresolved_prefix):
                              return ""
                          return value


                      raw = configured("REQUEST_JSON")
                      if not raw:
                          print("request_json is required", file=sys.stderr)
                          sys.exit(1)
                      try:
                          body = json.loads(raw)
                          if isinstance(body, str):
                              body = json.loads(body)
                      except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                          print("request_json is not valid JSON: " + str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
                          sys.exit(1)
                      if not isinstance(body, dict):
                          print("request_json must be a JSON object", file=sys.stderr)
                          sys.exit(1)
                      encoded = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(body, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).decode()
                      print("REQUEST_B64=" + encoded)
                      PY
                      )"
                      printf '%s\n' "$PREPARED_OUTPUT"
                      REQUEST_B64=""
                      while IFS='=' read -r name value; do
                        case "$name" in
                          REQUEST_B64) REQUEST_B64="$value" ;;
                        esac
                      done <<EOF
                      $PREPARED_OUTPUT
                      EOF
                      if [ -z "$REQUEST_B64" ]; then
                        echo "Prepare step failed to produce REQUEST_B64" >&2
                        exit 1
                      fi
                      export REQUEST_B64
                    outputVariables:
                      - name: REQUEST_B64
                        type: String
                        value: REQUEST_B64
              - step:
                  type: Agent
                  name: Run Incident Comms
                  identifier: run_agent_step
                  timeout: 40m
                  spec:
                    agentName: ca_incident_comms
                    agentSettings: |-
                      {
                        "llmConnector": "<+pipeline.variables.llmConnector>",
                        "team_name": "<+pipeline.variables.team_name>",
                        "modelName": "<+pipeline.variables.modelName>",
                        "agent_request_b64": "<+execution.steps.prepare_request.output.outputVariables.REQUEST_B64>",
                        "status_template": "<+pipeline.variables.status_template>",
                        "severity": "<+pipeline.variables.severity>",
                        "atlassian_cloud_id": "<+pipeline.variables.atlassian_cloud_id>",
                        "harness_api_key": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_api_key_secret>",
                        "harness_base_url": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_base_url>",
                        "harness_account_id": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_account_id>",
                        "harness_org": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_org>",
                        "harness_project": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_project>",
                        "team_skill_git_url": "<+pipeline.variables.team_skill_git_url>",
                        "team_skill_git_ref": "<+pipeline.variables.team_skill_git_ref>",
                        "team_skill_path": "<+pipeline.variables.team_skill_path>",
                        "plugin_git_user": "<+pipeline.variables.plugin_git_user>",
                        "plugin_git_token": "<+pipeline.variables.plugin_git_token_secret>"
                      }
              - step:
                  type: Run
                  name: Export Summary
                  identifier: export_summary
                  timeout: 5m
                  spec:
                    shell: Bash
                    command: |-
                      set -euo pipefail
                      SUMMARY_FILE="/harness/.agent/output/summary.md"
                      if [ ! -s "$SUMMARY_FILE" ]; then
                        echo "Missing or empty summary at $SUMMARY_FILE" >&2
                        ls -la /harness/.agent/output || true
                        exit 1
                      fi
                      echo "--- Agent summary ---"
                      cat "$SUMMARY_FILE"
                      echo "--- End summary ---"
                      SUMMARY_B64="$(python3 -c 'import base64,pathlib; print(base64.b64encode(pathlib.Path("/harness/.agent/output/summary.md").read_bytes()).decode(), end="")')"
                      echo "SUMMARY_B64=${SUMMARY_B64}"
                    outputVariables:
                      - name: SUMMARY_B64
                        type: String
                        value: SUMMARY_B64
              - step:
                  type: Run
                  name: Post Summary To Slack
                  identifier: post_summary_to_slack
                  timeout: 5m
                  when:
                    stageStatus: Success
                    condition: <+pipeline.variables.slack_thread_ts> != "" || <+pipeline.variables.slack_channel_id> != ""
                  spec:
                    shell: Bash
                    envVariables:
                      SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: <+pipeline.variables.slack_bot_token_secret>
                      SLACK_CHANNEL_ID: <+pipeline.variables.slack_channel_id>
                      SLACK_THREAD_TS: <+pipeline.variables.slack_thread_ts>
                      SUMMARY_B64: <+execution.steps.export_summary.output.outputVariables.SUMMARY_B64>
                      TITLE: <+pipeline.variables.team_name>
                      PIPELINE_EXECUTION_URL: <+pipeline.executionUrl>
                    command: |-
                      set -euo pipefail
                      python3 - <<'PY'
                      import base64, json, os, re, urllib.request

                      SLACK_TS_RE = re.compile(r"^\d+\.\d+$")
                      SLACK_P_RE = re.compile(r"(?:^|/)p(\d{10,})(?:\b|[/?#]|$)")
                      SLACK_CHANNEL_RE = re.compile(r"/archives/([CGD][A-Z0-9]+)/", re.I)


                      def normalize_slack_ts(raw):
                          value = (raw or "").strip().strip('"').strip("'")
                          unresolved_prefix = chr(60) + chr(43)
                          if not value or value == "null" or value.startswith(unresolved_prefix):
                              return ""
                          if SLACK_TS_RE.match(value):
                              return value
                          match = SLACK_P_RE.search(value)
                          digits = match.group(1) if match else ""
                          if not digits or len(digits) <= 6:
                              return ""
                          return digits[:-6] + "." + digits[-6:]


                      token = (os.environ.get("SLACK_BOT_TOKEN") or "").strip()
                      if not token:
                          raise RuntimeError("slack_bot_token_secret is required to post")
                      thread_raw = os.environ.get("SLACK_THREAD_TS", "").strip()
                      channel_match = SLACK_CHANNEL_RE.search(thread_raw)
                      channel_id = (channel_match.group(1).upper() if channel_match else os.environ.get("SLACK_CHANNEL_ID", "").strip())
                      if not channel_id:
                          raise RuntimeError("Set slack_channel_id or pass a Slack permalink")
                      summary_b64 = os.environ.get("SUMMARY_B64", "").strip()
                      if not summary_b64:
                          raise RuntimeError("Missing summary")
                      summary = base64.b64decode(summary_b64 + "=" * (-len(summary_b64) % 4)).decode()
                      team = os.environ.get("TITLE", "agent").strip()
                      exec_url = os.environ.get("PIPELINE_EXECUTION_URL", "").strip()
                      footer = f"\n_<{exec_url}|pipeline execution>_" if exec_url.startswith("http") else ""
                      thread_ts = normalize_slack_ts(thread_raw)
                      body = {
                          "channel": channel_id,
                          "text": (f"*[{team}]*\n" + summary + footer)[:39000],
                          "unfurl_links": False,
                          "unfurl_media": False,
                      }
                      if thread_ts:
                          body["thread_ts"] = thread_ts
                      req = urllib.request.Request(
                          "https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage",
                          data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
                          headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token, "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8"},
                          method="POST",
                      )
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp:
                          data = json.loads(resp.read())
                      if not data.get("ok"):
                          raise RuntimeError("chat.postMessage: " + str(data.get("error")))
                      print("Posted Slack ts=" + str(data.get("ts")))
                      PY
        failureStrategies:
          - onFailure:
              errors:
                - AllErrors
              action:
                type: MarkAsFailure

                        "harness_org": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_org>",
                        "harness_project": "<+pipeline.variables.harness_project>",

                        "plugin_git_token": "<+pipeline.variables.plugin_git_token_secret>"
                      }
              - step:
